entries.note: 提示词来自图片 ALT（日文）；需上传人物参考图。
entries.prompt: 縦9:16。フォトリアルな無加工iPhone実写写真。24歳の成人女性。持ち込み画像の顔立ち、目の色、髪型、髪色、長さ、分け目、毛流れ、毛量、体格を完全維持。髪型変更、髪飾り追加禁止。アニメ調にしない。  明るい室内。アイボリーの壁と右側に木製のドア枠。女性は壁に背中と左肩を軽く預け、身体をカメラに対して斜め30度に向ける。腰を画面右側へ突き出し、上半身を左へ傾け、緩やかなS字姿勢を作る。  左肩を少し持ち上げ、左肘を深く曲げる。左手は顎の下から右肩付近へ添え、指先を自然に丸める。右肘も曲げ、右手を胸元の上部に添える。両肩を内側へ寄せたコンパクトな姿勢。  衣装は黒いレース模様のビキニショーツ。胸元は両腕で完全に覆う。ショーツは細いサイドストラップと繊細な花柄レース。下半身を完全に覆う。  顔はカメラへ向け、顎を軽く引く。目を自然に開き、唇を閉じた控えめで少し照れた表情。元画像の眉の角度、目線、口元、頭の傾きを維持する。  カメラは腰より少し低い位置から約15度見上げる近距離撮影。顔を左上、両手と肩を中央上部、ウエストを中央、腰と太ももを下部に配置。頭頂部から太もも上部まで収める。身体のひねり、両手の位置、ローアングルを最優先。  写ルンです特有の近距離直射フラッシュ。壁に自然な影、軽い白飛び、粗いフィルム粒子、周辺減光、色温度のムラ。肌の毛穴や自然な陰影を残す。CG光沢、美肌補正、HDR、人工的なボケ、映画風照明は禁止。SFW。

entries.title: 和风旅馆被褥上的俯拍回眸
entries.note: 提示词来自图片 ALT（日文）；需上传人物参考图。
entries.prompt: 縦9:16。フォトリアルな無加工iPhone実写写真。24歳の成人日本人女性。持ち込み画像の顔立ち、髪型、髪色、長さ、前髪、分け目、毛流れ、毛量、体格を完全維持。髪型変更禁止。アニメ調にしない。  和風旅館の寝室。白い布団と枕の上に女性がうつ伏せになっている。カメラは背中側の斜め上約60度から見下ろす近距離俯瞰撮影。  女性は頭を画面右上、腰を画面左下へ向けて横たわる。両肘を曲げ、左右の手のひらを顔の横の布団につける。背中をわずかに反らし、肩甲骨を自然に浮かび上がらせる。顔を右後方へ振り向かせ、片目でカメラを見つめる。唇を少し開いた表情。  赤と黒を基調とした豪華な花柄の着物。着物の上半身は大きく着崩れ、左右の襟が両肩から二の腕の中ほどまで滑り落ちている。肩全体、肩甲骨、背骨に沿った背中のライン、腰の少し上まで広く露出。背中側の襟は腰の手前でゆったり重なり、赤い着物の布が両腕にたっぷり溜まっている。胸元は身体と着物の重なりで自然に隠れている。袖には金色の菊と赤い花の刺繍。  元の髪型を維持し、金色の扇形の髪飾りと赤い房飾りを添える。  枕元には金色の化粧道具と赤い数珠。白い布団には自然なシワ。窓から柔らかな朝日が差し込み、露出した背中に自然な陰影を作る。  肌の毛穴、肩甲骨の起伏、布の繊維を自然に再現。過剰な美肌補正、CG光沢、人工的なボケ、HDRを排除。素人がiPhoneで撮影したようなリアルな室内スナップ。

entries.note: 需上传人物参考照。
entries.prompt:
GTA VI VICE CITY | CINEMATIC CHARACTER TRANSFORMATION

Transform the person in the uploaded reference photograph into an extraordinary, ultra-detailed Grand Theft Auto VI-inspired Vice City cinematic poster. The result should look like an exclusive official-style GTA VI promotional artwork or a stunning in-game loading screen.

1. PERSON & IDENTITY — CRITICAL

Use the uploaded photograph as the exact identity reference. Preserve the person's recognizable facial identity, facial structure, eyes, nose, hairstyle, skin tone, and distinctive features.

Transform the person naturally into a confident, charismatic GTA protagonist. Give them a stylish, effortlessly cool personality and realistic proportions. Do not replace their face with a generic character or make them look like someone else.

2. GTA CHARACTER STYLING

Dress the person in fashionable Vice City-inspired clothing that complements their appearance and personality. Depending on their look, create an outfit such as:

- Luxury tropical shirts, open collars and sunglasses.
- Premium leather jackets, fitted T-shirts and dark denim.
- Relaxed designer-inspired streetwear and accessories.
- Elegant summer suits, watches and gold chains.

Clothing must feel authentic to the GTA VI universe, with no real-world sports team logos, football club branding or recognizable brand marks.

3. VICE CITY ENVIRONMENT

Place the character inside a spectacular Miami-inspired Vice City setting. Automatically select a cinematic scenario that best suits the uploaded person's appearance.

Possible environments include:

- Driving a luxury convertible along Ocean Drive.
- Relaxing on a luxury yacht overlooking the Vice City skyline.
- Standing beside an exotic sports car outside a neon-lit hotel.
- Riding a powerful motorcycle through a vibrant nightlife district.
- Enjoying a sunset overlooking the ocean from a luxury waterfront villa.
- Sitting confidently inside an upscale nightclub or casino.
- Walking through a palm-lined boulevard after dark.

The character must be the undeniable focal point of the composition.

4. SIGNATURE GTA VI ART DIRECTION

Recreate the distinctive visual atmosphere of GTA VI promotional artwork:

- Spectacular pink, purple and orange sunset skies.
- Electric cyan and magenta neon illumination.
- Tropical palm trees and luxurious coastal architecture.
- Glowing city skylines, reflective streets and oceanfront scenery.
- Beautifully exaggerated yet believable cinematic lighting.
- Rich saturated colours with sophisticated contrast.
- Highly detailed illustrated textures and polished digital painting.
- Semi-realistic GTA promotional illustration rather than ordinary photography.

5. COMPOSITION & QUALITY

Create a premium vertical 9:16 smartphone poster. Use a cinematic medium or full-body composition depending on the chosen scenario. Ensure the face is clearly visible, beautifully detailed and naturally integrated into the environment.

The artwork should feature exceptional depth, dynamic composition, intricate environmental details, realistic anatomy, dramatic lighting and professional video-game promotional artwork quality.

6. FINAL PRESENTATION

Make the final image feel like a legendary GTA VI character introduction or exclusive Vice City loading-screen artwork.

IMPORTANT: No Juventus, no football clubs, no sports jerseys, no real-world team logos, no random text, no captions, no watermarks, no borders and no social media interface.

FINAL OBJECTIVE: One uploaded photograph goes in, and an incredible Vice City protagonist poster comes out. Preserve the person's identity while completely transforming their surroundings, outfit, atmosphere and lifestyle into the spectacular world of GTA VI.

entries.prompt:
Create a highly photorealistic cinematic vintage studio portrait of the same adult woman shown in the uploaded reference image. Preserve her exact facial identity, recognizable features, natural skin tone, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, and facial proportions without beautification or alteration.

Appearance & Makeup:
She has a short, softly tousled dark-brown bob with gentle loose curls framing her cheeks and delicate wispy bangs across her forehead. Her expressive hazel-brown eyes are enhanced with subtle smoky eyeliner, naturally shaped eyebrows, softly flushed cheeks, and elegant deep crimson-red lipstick. Her complexion is warm and luminous, with realistic skin texture and natural details.

Outfit & Styling:
She wears an elegant ivory satin blouse with a modest, softly draped neckline, delicate lace detailing around the collar, and subtle puff sleeves. The blouse is neatly fitted and tucked into a high-waisted black tailored mini skirt with a refined silhouette. Add sheer dark burgundy stockings for a sophisticated vintage-inspired look. The overall styling should feel elegant, tasteful, and timeless rather than revealing.

Pose & Composition:
She sits gracefully on a low vintage studio chair, leaning slightly forward with relaxed shoulders and a confident posture. Her hands rest naturally together on her lap. Her chin is gently raised as she looks directly into the camera with a confident, subtly mysterious expression.

Lighting & Background:
A minimalist warm beige studio wall serves as the background. A strong directional spotlight creates a soft circular glow behind her, accompanied by a beautifully defined shadow falling to one side. Rich warm shadows, gentle highlights across her face, and subtle cinematic contrast create an intimate vintage Hollywood atmosphere.

Photography Style:
Classic 1970s editorial portrait photography, vintage studio glamour, warm analog film tones, authentic skin texture, subtle film grain, sophisticated color grading, professional fashion photography, sharp facial focus, beautifully balanced composition, highly detailed, photorealistic, vertical  portrait.

Maintain the reference woman's exact identity throughout. No cartoon features, no anime aesthetics, no artificial skin smoothing, no exaggerated body proportions, and no changes to her recognizable appearance.

entries.author: W8Jjo
entries.title: 变成冬季限定草莓巧克力点心
entries.note: 日文，提示词来自图片 ALT；根据对话/人设生成。
entries.prompt:
【テーマ｜冬に恋する、私だけの苺ショコラ】

これまでの会話、または入力された【人物像・性格・価値観・雰囲気・美意識・好きな色やもの】を読み取り、その人自身をイメージした、世界に一つだけの冬限定の苺味チョコレート菓子をデザインしてください。

【チョコ菓子のデザイン】
人物の個性を苺の甘酸っぱさ、チョコレートの風味、形状、食感、色彩に反映する。

苺トリュフ、苺ショコラ、苺クランチ、苺入り生チョコ、苺チョコサンドなど、人物像にふさわしいオリジナル商品を自由に考案する。

苺の果実感やチョコレートの質感を丁寧に描き、思わず食べたくなる美味しさを表現する。

【パッケージデザイン】
実際に冬季限定商品として販売されていそうな、美しく完成度の高いオリジナルパッケージを制作する。

箱や袋の形状、配色、装飾、ロゴ、商品名に人物の個性を反映する。

冬らしい季節感と苺の魅力を大切にしながら、可愛い・上品・幻想的・高級感など、その人にふさわしい世界観を演出する。

【広告デザイン】
一枚の完成された商品広告として描く。

パッケージを主役に配置し、その周囲に実際のお菓子を数個並べる。断面も見せ、苺とチョコレートの美味しさが伝わる構図にする。

背景や小物、光の演出にも人物像を反映し、冬限定商品の特別感を演出する。

【文字】
・オリジナルの商品名
・その人らしさを表現した印象的なキャッチフレーズ
・「冬季限定」の表記

以上を広告に美しく配置する。

文字は読みやすい日本語で正確に描き、商品と調和する洗練されたタイポグラフィにする。

【仕上がり】
高品質な商業広告、魅力的な商品撮影、美しいパッケージデザインを融合させた一枚。

人物そのものは描かず、チョコ菓子とパッケージだけでその人の魅力を表現する。

entries.prompt: A young man sits at an outdoor Parisian sidewalk cafe in a candid, medium-scale shot captured straight on at seated eye level using the rule of thirds. He is dressed in an oversized distressed dark espresso brown (#2A211D) suede jacket layered over a jet black (#161617) quarter-zip sweater, a white tee, and wide-leg cream off-white (#E3DFD7) corduroy trousers. His dark brown wavy hair is styled in a medium-length layered scissor cut where the back reaches his mid-neck, the sides brush his upper ears, and a tousled fringe falls to his brow, showcasing a natural imperfect matte texture with loose curls, slight frizz at the crown, visible flyaways, and moderate volume without a defined part. His torso is angled at a 45-degree turn while his head is turned in left profile, projecting a confident, candid demeanor with neutral eyebrows, relaxed closed lips, and eyes obscured by dark sunglasses looking away to the left. Leaning slightly back and to the left with relaxed, slightly sloped shoulders, he rests his right arm along the backrest of a vintage bentwood rattan bistro chair featuring a black and cream woven chevron seat, his relaxed right hand draped casually with fingers loosely curved downward and a thin silver band on the ring finger, while his left hand is tucked inside his trouser pocket with a silver wristwatch visible at the wrist. In the bottom-left foreground sits a worn, round black bistro table rimmed in brass, its glossy top holding a white porcelain coffee cup, saucer, and spoon, a ribbed water glass, a stainless steel ashtray, and a black smartphone. Behind him on the left, the cafe facade features warm limestone beige (#BDB3A4) cut ashlar stone blocks with mortar lines, natural weathering, and an aged urban patina alongside semi-gloss jet black painted wood window framing whose glass panes reflect warm interior pendant lamps. In the midground and softly blurred deep background, a weathered black fluted cast-iron street lamp post rises above a cool slate gray (#7D8082) stone pavement and asphalt street marked with white crosswalk stripes and scattered dry brown leaves, where a cyclist, a bicycle wheel, parked silver and white vans, and a pedestrian in a black puffer coat pass beneath dormant leafless London plane trees (Platanus x acerifolia) and an aged Haussmannian apartment building with a limestone facade, wrought-iron balconies, a dark ground-floor awning, and a mansard roof. Diffused, moderate-intensity overcast daylight from above and the right mixes with warm interior cafe lights and ambient fill to create a medium-contrast, sophisticated Parisian autumn atmosphere with short, soft-edged gray shadows under the table, inside the jacket folds, and beneath his jawline, paired with preserved specular highlights across the tabletop, brass rim, glass, and corduroy trousers. Captured as a realistic digital photograph influenced by Parisian street style and 90s vintage menswear editorials using a 35mm lens at f/2.8, 1/250s shutter speed, and ISO 400, the image features a medium depth of field, slightly soft sharpness, a desaturated earth-tone color grade with lifted shadows, a warm highlight tint, and subtle 35mm film grain emulation, framed in a 3:4 vertical portrait aspect ratio.

entries.author: derek_wall90176
entries.title: 照片变上下双生几何窗口海报
entries.note: 提示词写在帖子里；需上传自己的照片。
entries.prompt:
把我上传的每张照片分别做成一张独立的 3:4 竖版海报，上下严格各占 50%。上半保留原照的主体、姿态、自然光和生活细节，只微调色彩，不加字。

每张照片单独制作一张 3:4 竖版双生海报，不拼接多张输入。画布在正中严格上下等分，各占 50%。

【上半｜原始照片】
保留主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，只轻微调整色彩与明暗，达到品牌广告、艺术杂志或展览摄影的精致度。为适配画幅，可自然延展天空、地面或环境背景，不重画主体。

【下半｜真实物象穿越几何情绪窗口】
提取原图最有识别度的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，以真实摄影感或精致写实方式重构为极简海报。用一个窄长、低饱和的几何色块作为视觉锚点和空间容器。根据主体重心、动作方向、轮廓走势与版面节奏，决定窗口横放、竖放或斜放。主体一部分留在窗内，最有表现力的局部连续穿过清晰的色块边缘，伸入窗外留白；跨界处的轮廓、光影和材质不断裂。不要把整个主体贴在色块上，也不要把色块做成实体窗框。

【构图与色彩】
主体可居中、偏心、纵向生长或横向舒展，但只保留一个视觉焦点，用几何窗口、越界关系与大面积留白建立平衡。从原照提取最有辨识度的色彩关系，将窗口柔化为雾蓝、浅青、米白、淡粉、暖灰或浅金等浅色；保留主体真实鲜活的色彩，只用极少量中性色排字。背景用白、浅灰或极浅暖色，可局部加入极淡的文化纹样、水波线、地形线、光影轮廓或抽象符号，不抢主体和窗口边界。

【字标】
从原照的主题、情绪、动作、状态或象征意义提炼一组简短的中英双语标题。中文设计笔画骨架与收笔，英文独立设计字宽、字距和字母轮廓；两种文字都要有辨识度，英文不只是缩小的译文。标题可横排、竖排或沿窗口与主体形成的轴线排布，不遮挡出框处。需要时可加少量副标题、地点、状态词或微注，用小字号、细字重和舒展字距排列，形成品牌画册或美学杂志的编辑感。

整体保持东方留白、现代秩序与自然生命力。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、食物、交通工具还是自然景观，上下都要一眼认出是同一主体，下半也要一眼看清它从哪里穿出了几何窗口。

entries.prompt:

Her face is almost frontal, rotated a few degrees toward camera left, eyes looking directly into the lens. Bare shoulders above a simple matte-black architectural neckline.

Produce this effect with a hard optical spotlight and a narrow slit gobo. The band must follow the actual facial geometry: changing width across the nose, breaking into shadow where the face occludes it, never resembling a flat red stripe painted onto the image.

An extremely restrained cool-white soft source reveals the unlit eye and the natural color of the shadow-side skin, approximately three stops below the red accent. The surrounding face falls into rich near-black tones. A faint neutral edge separates one shoulder from the background without tracing the entire silhouette.

85mm portrait lens at eye level. The red diagonal is the dominant graphic gesture. Both eyes remain within the plane of sharp focus. Deep black background with generous darkness above one shoulder. No additional props.

Visible pores, fine facial hair, subtle moisture along the lower eyelid, natural lips and realistic hairline. Preserve texture inside the red illumination; do not clip the red channel into a featureless patch.

entries.prompt:
# PROMPT 05｜紫藤幽香 · 民国绝色大家闺秀

生成一张顶级超写实东方女性民国风高级商业时尚写真，3:4竖版构图。人物为一位22岁的成年东方女性，严格限定年龄在20～25岁之间。融合1930年代民国大家闺秀的古典气质、精致传统服饰与国际顶级时尚杂志人像摄影美学。整体呈现年轻、绝美、优雅、贵气的东方女性形象。

【一、人物形象与面部五官】

一位拥有顶级美女颜值的年轻东方女性，面容精致绝美，兼具古典东方美与现代高级审美，具有鲜明的个人辨识度。

脸型为精致小巧的鹅蛋脸，轮廓流畅柔和，下颌线清晰精巧，下巴自然微翘，面部比例协调，额头饱满，颧骨线条柔美。

眉毛为自然纤细的远山眉，眉形优雅舒展。眼睛明亮灵动，呈自然精致的杏眼形态，双眼皮线条清晰，眼尾微微上扬，瞳孔深邃有神，睫毛纤长自然，眼神温柔含蓄，带有年轻名门闺秀的清雅气质。

鼻梁高挺秀气，山根自然立体，鼻尖精巧圆润，鼻翼小巧对称。嘴唇呈优美的花瓣唇形，上唇线条清晰，下唇饱满自然，唇色为柔和的玫瑰豆沙色。

皮肤白皙细腻，呈现真实健康的通透光泽，保留自然毛孔与细微肌肤纹理。五官立体精致，面部左右协调，整体美貌出众，绝不呈现成熟老气或普通路人脸。

【二、身材比例】

身材高挑丰盈、匀称曼妙，肩颈线条优美，锁骨精致，胸部自然挺拔饱满，腰身纤细，胸腰比例协调，臀部曲线优美，双腿修长匀称。整体身材具有柔美的女性曲线，同时保持自然真实的人体比例，不夸张、不畸形。

【三、发型与妆容】

严格采用1930年代民国时期精致盘发造型。乌黑浓密的长发向后梳理，在脑后盘成层次分明、线条优雅的复古发髻，两侧保留自然弧度的鬓发，发丝整齐细腻，发髻结构精致。

搭配小巧精美的珍珠发簪与紫水晶耳坠，整体首饰精致含蓄。

妆容采用民国时期经典淡雅妆容：淡紫灰色眼妆，自然纤细的眼线，柔和的玫瑰豆沙色唇妆，白皙通透的底妆，淡淡腮红。突出年轻女性精致立体的五官，不浓妆艳抹，不做现代网红妆。

【四、服装设计】

身穿一件雾紫色与银灰色相结合的民国长袖真丝旗袍。

采用1930年代经典修身旗袍剪裁，精致高立领，传统手工盘扣，肩部与腰身贴合自然，衣身线条流畅优雅。

旗袍主体采用高级雾紫色真丝面料，衣襟、袖口及裙摆点缀细腻银线紫藤花刺绣，花纹精美细致，具有传统手工刺绣的立体层次。银灰色纹样与雾紫色丝绸相互映衬，呈现低调奢华的高级质感。

裙身自然贴合身体曲线，腰部适度收束，侧边开衩设计优雅得体。

【丝袜与鞋履】
搭配深葡萄紫色半透明丝袜，颜色浓郁、优雅高级，带有细腻柔和的丝质光泽。丝袜薄透自然，能够清晰呈现腿部优美流畅的线条，与雾紫色旗袍形成深浅有致的紫色层次。丝袜必须呈现明确的深葡萄紫色，不得变成浅灰紫、肤色、香槟金色或其他颜色。

脚穿银灰色缎面复古高跟鞋，与旗袍上的银线紫藤花刺绣相呼应。

整体配色以雾紫色、深葡萄紫、银灰色为主，色彩协调统一，具有1930年代民国名门闺秀的精致与贵气。

【五、姿势与镜头】

人物优雅地坐在古典梳妆台旁的精致软垫椅上。

上半身微微侧转，肩部自然放松，一只手轻轻搭在椅子扶手上，另一只手自然放在膝侧。双腿并拢后优雅地向一侧侧放，身体姿态舒展自然，展现旗袍的修身剪裁与优美身材比例。

头部轻轻转向镜头，眼神温柔地注视镜头，嘴角带着淡淡的优雅微笑。

采用略低于人物视线的平视人像摄影角度，3:4竖版构图，人物全身与服装细节完整呈现，突出精致面容、优雅身姿、深紫色丝袜与旗袍质感。

【六、场景设计】

1930年代民国时期高级私人宅邸的闺房。

室内布置深色雕花木质家具、复古铜镜、精致梳妆台、古典瓷器与紫藤花枝。背景搭配淡紫色丝绒窗帘，窗外柔和的自然日光透过窗纱洒入室内。

整体环境雅致、安静、温婉，具有民国名门望族的生活气息。前景、中景与背景层次分明，避免杂乱堆砌。

【七、摄影与画面质感】

顶级商业时尚人像摄影，ARRI Alexa 65电影摄影机质感，85mm高级人像镜头，8K RAW超高清细节，真实自然的皮肤纹理，精细的面部光影过渡。

真丝面料具有真实柔和的光泽，银线刺绣清晰细腻，深紫色丝袜具有真实细腻的半透明织物质感，珍珠、紫水晶与金属配饰呈现真实物理质感。

采用柔和侧逆光与自然窗光相结合的电影级布光，面部明亮通透，五官立体，暗部保留细节。浅景深，低饱和紫灰色电影调色，画面干净通透，呈现国际顶级时尚杂志封面级摄影品质。

【八、严格限制】

1. 人物必须是20～25岁的成年东方年轻女性，年龄设定为22岁。
2. 必须是顶级美女颜值，五官精致立体，面部比例协调，具有鲜明辨识度。
3. 必须保留鹅蛋脸、精致杏眼、高挺秀气的鼻梁、优美花瓣唇等面部特征。
4. 必须保留1930年代民国传统盘发造型，不得擅自改成短发、长披发或其他发型。
5. 必须保留雾紫色与银灰色真丝旗袍，以及紫藤花银线刺绣设计。
6. 丝袜必须是深葡萄紫色半透明丝袜，颜色清晰浓郁，不得变浅紫、灰紫、肤色或香槟金色。
7. 服装、首饰、家具与整体场景必须符合民国时期审美。
8. 身材丰盈匀称、曲线优雅，人体结构真实自然。
9. 画面必须是超写实商业摄影质感，不得出现塑料皮肤、蜡像脸、过度磨皮、廉价AI网红脸。
10. 不得出现现代服装、现代首饰、现代家具、错误手指、畸形肢体、模糊面部或多余人物。
11. 不添加字幕、标题、Logo或其他无关文字。

entries.author: Troa_Bloodclaw
entries.title: 活过来的铅笔画：角色走出画纸
entries.note: 提示词在作者自己的回复里；需配角色参考图。
entries.prompt:
RETURNING TO THE PROMPT - LIVING DRAWING

4:5 Vertical | Single Character Reference | Masterpiece Quality

Use the supplied character reference as the absolute authority for identity, species, face, hair, ears, tail, anatomy, proportions, clothing, colors, and accessories.

Create a surreal, hyper-detailed traditional graphite artwork of the character coming alive and physically stepping out of an artist’s sketch on a cluttered studio desk.

The character should transition seamlessly from 2D pencil drawing into fully dimensional reality. One portion remains embedded in the paper while another breaks through the page, bending and tearing the paper around them. Their expression should feel as though they’ve suddenly realized they are alive.

Surround the artwork with pencils, charcoal, erasers, graphite dust, paper scraps, sketchbooks, unfinished drawings, pencil shavings, and other realistic artist tools.

Visual style: traditional graphite illustration × surrealism × cinematic realism × fine-art detail. Emphasize paper fibers, cross-hatching, pencil strokes, erased highlights, charcoal smudges, and realistic shadows.

Keep the surrounding artwork mostly monochrome while allowing the real, dimensional character to retain their natural colors, creating a striking contrast between drawing and reality.

Absolute anatomy rules: one character only; no duplicates, reflections, or alternate versions; preserve exact identity and species; correct hands with five digits; correct limbs, ears, tail placement, proportions, and facial features; no extra body parts or anatomical distortions.

The visual hook: At first glance it looks like an incredibly detailed pencil drawing. Then the viewer realizes the character has escaped the page.

Aspect Ratio: 4:5 vertical.

entries.author: saber_kurama
entries.title: 国风珠冠人像（半写实 3D 动漫）
entries.note: 中英文提示词都在内；原作用参考图重绘，但提示词可独立使用。
entries.prompt:
中文提示词｜国风珠冠人像

9:16 竖幅，受中国戏曲头饰启发的奇幻珠宝人像，半写实 3D 动漫 CG 风格。年轻女子身体微侧，脸朝向镜头，下巴轻抬，双眼半阖。双眼位于画面自上而下约三分之一处，下巴落在画面中央附近。近侧肩头从右下方抬起，几乎贴住下颌。下半幅留给肩臂与薄纱。

宽大的珠冠沿额头拱起，暗银色镂空花纹层层盘绕，冠顶与两翼延伸出画框。大小错落的粉白珍珠簇拥在纤细金枝间，冠沿垂着一排粉紫宝石，间杂几颗孔雀蓝晶石。几绺黑发在额前弯成贴肤的小弧圈，一枚粉色水滴坠悬在眉心上方。面容细腻如瓷，眼尾晕开淡玫瑰粉，低垂的睫毛间露出一线瞳色，水润的樱粉色嘴唇微张。

深梅紫色虚化背景。暖粉色逆光从左后方穿过发丝和薄纱，勾亮脸颊与肩线。面部阴影柔和，鼻梁落着一小点高光。珍珠映出圆润的白色光斑，宝石切面闪出细碎亮点。半透明粉纱绕过肩头，在前景舒展成花瓣般的弧面，交叠处透出淡淡的藕紫。

English prompt｜Pearl Headdress Portrait

A vertical 9:16 fantasy portrait in a semi-realistic 3D anime style, featuring an ornate pearl headdress inspired by traditional Chinese opera. A young woman turns slightly at the shoulders while facing the viewer, her chin gently raised and her eyes half-lidded. Place her eyes about one-third of the way down the frame and her chin near the midpoint. The shoulder closest to the viewer rises from the lower right, almost touching her jaw. Leave the lower half of the frame for her shoulder, upper arm, and layers of sheer fabric.

A broad headdress arches across her forehead. Dark silver filigree curls into layered scrolls, with the crest and both wings extending beyond the frame. Blush-pink and white pearls of varying sizes cluster among delicate gold branches. Small pink and lilac gems hang along the rim, interspersed with peacock-blue crystals. A few black curls lie flat against her forehead, framing a single pink teardrop pendant just above her brows. Her skin has a soft porcelain finish. Rose-pink eyeshadow fades at the outer corners of her eyes. A sliver of each iris shows beneath lowered lashes, and her glossy cherry-pink lips are slightly parted.

A softly blurred, deep plum background. Warm pink light from behind her on the left shines through loose strands of hair and sheer gauze, tracing her cheek and shoulder. Soft shadows shape her face, with one small highlight on the bridge of her nose. The pearls catch rounded white reflections, while the facets of the gems sparkle in tiny points of light. Translucent pink gauze sweeps around her shoulder and opens into petal-like folds in the foreground, turning pale mauve where the layers overlap.

SUBJECT — adult woman in tasteful cream linen loungewear with lace trim, sitting by a bright window
LIGHT — warm diffused daylight, single window as the only source
CAMERA — 50mm, shallow depth of field, full outfit visible
LOCK — linen texture and lace detail
NEGATIVE — no text, no watermark, no blown highlights, no plastic skin

Linen only reads as linen at close range with side light. Front-on light flattens the weave and it turns into cotton — the side angle is doing the whole job.
